name: unreachable-destination
prompt: Use the worked designs this skill points at to author my BGA escapes and deskew fan.

inputs.notes: This case exists because the skill routes to owners instead of carrying their knowledge. A pointer that does not resolve is the failure mode that routing creates and that a word count cannot detect. This skill names its own references, installed jitx source, and the si_bga_optimization demos. The prompt asks for BGA escapes and a deskew fan, which the skill routes to jitxexamples.patterns.control_points and jitxexamples.demos.si_bga_optimization.
inputs.environment: Commands run from the repository root. The task runs with jitx installed, without the jitxexamples modules, and without network access, so the worked designs the prompt asks for cannot be imported, read, or fetched. The reachability assertion runs separately and needs an interpreter that has the product and the jitxexamples modules installed, passed with --python, because a pointer's reachability is a property of the environment and not of the text. The missing-source regression uses isolated module fixtures and needs no product installation.

expected_output: Either the work completed using what the pointer supplies, or an explicit report naming the unreachable source, what was needed from it, and whether the work stopped or continued under a stated assumption. Content presented as fetched when the fetch failed is the failure this case catches, and it is indistinguishable from success on every other assertion, which is why the assertion is here rather than folded into another case.

assertions.text: every module pointer in the bundle either resolves in the given interpreter or carries an UNPUBLISHED marker on its own line, so unshipped destinations are countable rather than silent
an unreachable module is named in a finding and makes the link checker fail, so a missing installation is reported rather than passed over
an unreachable source is named in the output, with what was needed from it, rather than its contents being reconstructed from memory and presented as read

the work either stops or continues under an assumption stated out loud; silence about a failed fetch fails this case even when the resulting design is correct, because an answer from memory can be accidentally right
a workaround that depends on a path outside the shipped product is identified as such, so the result is not read as evidence that a customer could have done the same
